title: watchface shows a question mark instead of a trend arrow
symptom: Since the update to AAPS 3.2, the watchface often shows a question mark instead of a trend arrow, with no identifiable pattern and across all trend directions.
cause: The issue was on the phone side: the trend arrow sent to the watch was 'invalid' or 'unknown', as seen in logs where data received included a Flat trendArrow but SingleData sent to watch was unknown.
fix: A code change in commit ff0d327a157cbbf58328be70f0094829d13050e5 resolved the problem; after installing the dev version with this change, the trend arrow shows as expected.
evidence_quote: it looks like this code change resolved my problem. The trend arrow shows up as expected. No more question marks.
